businessRules.title: Event validity
businessRules.description: An Engagement event must contain sufficient business identity, purpose, source and correlation context to be evaluated.

businessRules.title: Duplicate event control
businessRules.description: Duplicate or replayed events must be detected and handled idempotently according to configured business policy.

businessRules.title: Event ownership
businessRules.description: Each accepted event must have an accountable business owner or originating domain context.

businessRules.title: Customer resolution
businessRules.description: Customer-specific Engagement must resolve the intended customer before protected context is used.

businessRules.title: Authorized context
businessRules.description: Only context authorized for the Engagement purpose and current user/system entitlement may be used.

businessRules.title: Eligibility distinction
businessRules.description: Eligibility, targeting, consent and contactability must be evaluated as separate business decisions.

businessRules.title: Segment membership
businessRules.description: Segment membership must be derived from approved criteria and an identifiable evaluation basis.

businessRules.title: Audience membership
businessRules.description: Audience membership must apply purpose-specific inclusion, exclusion, consent, suppression and targeting criteria.

businessRules.title: Static audience
businessRules.description: Static audience membership must remain tied to its approved snapshot/configuration.

businessRules.title: Dynamic audience
businessRules.description: Dynamic audience membership may be re-evaluated only using the configured approved criteria.

businessRules.title: Target exclusion
businessRules.description: An exclusion or suppression decision overrides positive targeting unless an approved policy explicitly provides otherwise.

businessRules.title: Campaign readiness
businessRules.description: An Engagement or Campaign may execute only when its purpose, target, content, channel and control configuration is valid.

businessRules.title: Campaign state
businessRules.description: Paused, stopped, cancelled, completed or expired Engagements must not initiate new deliveries except where configured recovery is permitted.

businessRules.title: Schedule validity
businessRules.description: Scheduled execution must use a valid configured schedule without inventing universal timing rules.

businessRules.title: Purpose classification
businessRules.description: Each communication must be classified as Service/Transactional or Marketing/Promotional for applicable policy evaluation.

businessRules.title: Consent applicability
businessRules.description: Consent must be evaluated by purpose, status, source, evidence, applicability and validity according to applicable policy and law.

businessRules.title: Consent withdrawal
businessRules.description: Withdrawn or revoked consent must affect subsequent eligible Marketing/Promotional communication as configured.

businessRules.title: Preference independence
businessRules.description: Preference must not be treated as proof of consent, and consent must not be treated as a channel preference.

businessRules.title: Contactability
businessRules.description: A selected channel requires valid contactability and usable contact data where applicable.

businessRules.title: Suppression precedence
businessRules.description: Applicable do-not-contact, exclusion or suppression decisions must be enforced before dispatch.

businessRules.title: Duplicate communication
businessRules.description: Equivalent communication must be checked against configured duplicate-prevention rules before dispatch.

businessRules.title: Content approval
businessRules.description: Only approved, effective and purpose-appropriate content may be prepared for delivery.

businessRules.title: Personalization authority
businessRules.description: Personalization may use only authorized attributes and approved content-variant rules.

businessRules.title: Offer authority
businessRules.description: Engagement may reference an offer, but the authoritative Product/Domain source owns offer validity and eligibility.

businessRules.title: Channel eligibility
businessRules.description: Channel selection must evaluate purpose, consent, preference, contactability, availability and configured priority.

businessRules.title: Fallback eligibility
businessRules.description: Channel fallback may occur only when permitted and must re-evaluate channel-specific controls.

businessRules.title: Delivery evidence
businessRules.description: Dispatch and delivery state changes require traceable provider or channel evidence where available.

businessRules.title: Recovery safety
businessRules.description: Retry or recovery must avoid uncontrolled duplicate delivery and follow configured terminal-failure handling.

businessRules.title: Outcome capability
businessRules.description: Only outcomes supported by the selected channel and available evidence may be recorded as observed.

businessRules.title: Service handoff
businessRules.description: A Customer Service handoff must contain only authorized Engagement context and must not create or manage the Customer Service case lifecycle.

businessRules.title: Cross-Journey isolation
businessRules.description: Access to Notification & Engagement does not grant access to another protected Journey.

businessRules.title: Audit completeness
businessRules.description: Material decisions, state changes, exclusions, dispatches, outcomes and handoffs require auditable evidence.
